svg.title: Beam as generator and as teacher
svg.desc: As the generator, Beam writes the task with a hidden ground truth, an initial-state test, the hidden verifier and a container definition, and repairs the definition from build errors. As the teacher, Beam solves the task in the container with a bash tool, and the verifier decides whether the attempt is kept.

g.text: Solves the environment it made, one command at a time.
Initial-state test: the image starts as described
Hidden verifier: tests behavior, not the agent's source
Container definition, repaired from build errors
Kept only if the image builds and the initial-state test passes.
Reads the task; works in the container with bash
Reasons, runs a bash command, reads the output, repeats
Submits; the hidden verifier runs in the same container
Pass: the whole trajectory becomes a golden trace
Two attempts per environment; the shortest passing one is trace_0.
